title: Freekeh with Fried Herbs
subtitle: served with goat's yoghurt
description: Freekeh simmered with garlic and a mountain of herbs that have been fried until crisp, best eaten at room temperature with thick goat's yoghurt.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a shallow pot and fry the herbs in several batches of 3 to 4 minutes each, until they change colour and turn crisp (careful, the oil may spit).
Transfer the fried herbs to a sieve and season with 1/2 tsp salt.
Pour most of the strained oil, except 3 tbsp, into a jar or bottle and keep out of the fridge for up to a month.

Heat the remaining oil in the pot and cook the garlic over low heat for about 1 minute until soft but not burnt. Add the freekeh, stir and fry for about 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper, add the herbs and stir. Add the water (or vegetable stock), stir and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally and adding a little liquid if needed. Turn off the heat, place a towel over the pot and the lid on top and rest for 20 minutes.
Serve at room temperature with goat's yoghurt on the side.
